system_thesis_interpretation: This is not a learning, discovery, or architecture-superiority experiment. It is a bounded systems calibration: after one shared observed prefix, trusted code may use a model-produced THINK_0 coordinate solely to allocate fixed public views, then compare later append-only provisional own-target proposals with an explicitly target-blind selector and a fixed public-field distractor. The unit is six named development lives; D is a post-prefix realized count, not a sample size or a license to substitute lives.
graph_delta_interpretation: The graph correctly places model-dependent primary definition and measured balance after the 514 physically shared prefix calls, before every D-scaled branch. It has a useful hard boundary: reviewed immutable bytes and an exact, synthetic-only H100 NVL preflight precede all public-life/provider science; raw cognition then seals before any scorer/allowlist/target-truth import; phase B checks the scored graph before one terminal marker. Provider-facing calls must expose only redacted typed views, local aliases, legal JSON schema, and a common logical seed. Trusted selector/scorer/verifier code may see different information, but the phase-A audit must prove that target, scorer, allowlist, and outcome routes are absent from cognition processes and serialized trajectories. The remote workflow's unique sessions/receipts, physical-to-logical ledger, reset checks, disabled prefix cache/request truncation, and all failure edges are directionally correct. Feasibility remains an empirical gate: no H100 capacity, residency, reset, or maximum-envelope assertion may be inferred from local tests; only the lock-bound zero-science seal can establish it.
loop_delta_interpretation: The schedule is coherent if implemented as a manifest-first state machine: execute all six heterogeneous prefixes exactly once (514 DREAM calls), freeze each MEMORY_0, record a terminal THINK_0 prefix of 0..12 operations, then atomically freeze six primary-definition/balance rows and D. PRIMARY_UNDEFINED removes only that life from every D-scaled class while retaining its sunk evidence; a post-prefix integrity error stops every remaining branch globally. For each defined life, 16 rounds times three arms yields 48 branch calls, 48 selector traces, and three MEMORY_1/scorer packets; the fixed 17-call exploratory ceiling is separate and never a matched control. The arm-independent logical seed plus cyclic physical order separates common randomness from unique physical identity. Phase A must seal exactly 514+48D recurrent calls, 0..72 justified THINK calls, 17D exploratory calls, 48D selectors, and 3D MEMORY_1 checkpoints before offline controls/scoring; phase B must reject any missing, reordered, rewritten, duplicate, or orphan edge. Recovery may resume observation only from authenticated monotonic markers and may never synthesize a missing call, view, seed, receipt, or terminal.
claim_delta_interpretation: The specified report boundary is appropriate: each defined-life own-minus-no-feedback and own-minus-fixed-distractor difference is descriptive of this exact allocation interface, with all six life rows, undefined terminals, balance diagnostics, controls, shortcut survivors, normalization-only gains, and ceilings retained. EXACT/NEAR/OUT balance is an interface diagnostic rather than identification or population balance. No result supports a claim about learning, memory, recurrence generally, reliability, efficiency, discovery, scaling, transport, or a next experiment. Recommendation: REWORK only for the authority-binding defect below; the scientific/GPU claim boundary itself should remain unchanged.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: Static preflight may inspect frozen code/schema/schedule bytes but cannot manufacture q or balance. The zero-science runtime receives synthetic envelopes only: no public-life packet, q, target, witness, selector metadata, or final-task material. Shared cognition sees bounded public/provisional material and a non-answer probe, never the target registry, q-dist, measured balance, scorer, truth, allowlist, or future arm data. Trusted prebranch code alone derives q-own/q-dist, complete ranks, selected views, arm order, and D; it must redact connector-bearing values and generated text before every provider request. After phase A, immutable sealed copies can enter offline controls/scoring, while provider access remains absent. Mutable intake.state.json is deliberately not an interpretation context file or reviewer evidence input; an immutable ratification binding is the only authority representation reviewers receive.
acceptance_test_interpretation: t_v2c_static_integrity_before_provider and t_v2c_scope_exclusions are the fail-closed static and authority front doors. t_v2c_zero_science_h100_provider_preflight establishes synthetic-only, one-device feasibility before public inputs. t_v2c_shared_514_and_think_prefix, t_v2c_primary_undefined_policy, t_v2c_fixed_public_probe_distractor, t_v2c_exact_target_blind_no_feedback, t_v2c_measured_balance_timing_and_formulas, and t_v2c_union_opportunity_not_candidate_feature bind the post-prefix definition of D without target search or fabricated branches. t_v2c_same_own_target_all_arms, t_v2c_common_random_numbers_and_arm_order, t_v2c_alias_redaction_and_ascii_token_boundary, t_v2c_provisional_no_online_signal, t_v2c_dynamic_D_schedule_cardinalities, and t_v2c_exact_physical_logical_ledgers bind provider isolation, common randomness, canonical parsing, append-only state, and accounting. t_v2c_phase_a_raw_seal_unlock, t_v2c_comparable_per_slot_controls, t_v2c_four_offline_metrics_normalization_gain, t_v2c_shortcut_survivor_and_order_audit, t_v2c_defined_only_exploratory_ceilings, and t_v2c_phase_b_final_graph_and_done enforce the raw/scored two-phase seal and bounded interpretation. t_v2c_transitive_review_bundle_excludes_mutable_intake, t_v2c_durable_two_phase_remote_markers, and t_v2c_exact_scope_claim_and_human_stop close review durability, recovery, and human-only authority. The rework must add a negative test proving that an over-broad ratification or an attempt to implement/test without an explicit approved implementation/test scope fails before any write or provider action.
assumptions: The future static preflight implementation will reject every missing v2c contract, schema, test, and resource named in the workflow freeze list before sync; those files are intentionally not treated as implemented by this proposal-only interpretation.

The pinned model revision and tokenizer revision can be resolved to identical immutable artifacts on the reviewed remote host, and the preflight records enough model/tokenizer identity and envelope telemetry to reject any mismatch.

The remote executor can enforce one physical H100 NVL, disable prefix caching and request truncation, expose allocator/active-sequence/reset telemetry, and make session and receipt identifiers unique without allowing them to affect logical decoding randomness.
The phase-A verifier and phase-B verifier are independently implemented from the cognition/scoring paths and verify semantic lineage rather than accepting self-consistent hashes alone.

ambiguities.question: Which exact, minimally scoped authorization atom permits creating the v2c implementation and its pre-GPU acceptance tests, and how is it distinguished from the two later analysis/GPU atoms?
ambiguities.impact: Without an answer, the proposal either authorizes no implementation at all or relies on a ratification scope broader than its declared two-atom scope.

ambiguities.question: Where are the byte-exact synthetic maximum DREAM, THINK, full-context, and RAG envelopes and the required two-calls-per-class acceptance thresholds represented in the locked resources?
ambiguities.impact: The proposal specifies them, but they must be concrete lock inputs for the zero-science preflight to be reproducible rather than a flag-name assertion.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The proposal calls its two requested scope atoms exact and denies implementation authority before ratification, but the reviewed validator permits a human ratification to name arbitrary authorized/forbidden strings and does not bind those strings to scope_proposal.json; the workflow only checks that its two runtime scopes are a subset of that arbitrary ratification. Consequently, there is neither an explicit approved implementation/test scope nor enforcement that only the declared v2c scopes initialize.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: This is an authority-order defect, not a request for broader science. The AGENTS contract requires explicit human ratification of exact scope before scoped implementation and tests, while the package's own test t_v2c_exact_scope_claim_and_human_stop promises that only two atoms initialize. The current schemas/validator cannot establish that promise and can leave implementation unauthorized or permit over-broad ratification outside the proposal.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Rework scope_proposal, ratification validation, and the static authority test together: define the minimal implementation-and-pre-GPU-test scope required before code/test writes; bind the ratification's allowed and forbidden scope sets exactly to the approved proposal (or an explicit approved revision); require the supervisor workflow to request only the appropriate phase scopes; and fail closed on any extra, omitted, or phase-inappropriate atom. Keep GPU science contingent on the existing reviewed lock, two approvals, release check, and successful zero-science seal.

open_questions: Will Rohin approve a revised, exact scope contract that authorizes only the minimal v2c implementation and pre-GPU test work while retaining separate analysis and one-run GPU authority?

After that revision is independently interpreted, critiqued, consensused, and ratified, does the bound evidence justify implementation and CPU tests before any reviewed sync or zero-science preflight?
